# Alchemetryx

> We rebuild the job that lives in someone's head and a spreadsheet into a working system that runs itself.

Alchemetryx Ltd is an operational systems and software automation firm based in London, UK. We specialize in taking one critical, high-friction operational workflow inside growing businesses and turning it into a repeatable, automated system.

## Company Identity
- **Legal Name**: Alchemetryx Ltd
- **Company Number**: 17199377 (Registered in England & Wales)
- **Registered Office**: 83 Arthur Grove, London, England, SE18 7ES
- **Primary Contact**: support@alchemetryx.com
- **Website**: https://alchemetryx.com

## Core Value Proposition
- **The Problem**: Growing businesses accumulate disconnected software tools. A CRM here, a spreadsheet there. Tools don't connect, decisions slow down, and operations depend entirely on the owner.
- **The Philosophy**: "Your tools are not a system. Buying software is not the same as having something that runs."
- **The Solution**: Start with one job. We scope the engagement to a single critical process, map it, rebuild it as an automated system, and deliver one view to decide. AI sits inside it where it earns its place, and nowhere else.

## Published Case Studies (Proof)
- [Proof Overview](https://alchemetryx.com/proof): Real systems built and hosted on Alchemetryx infrastructure.
- [CareRota](https://alchemetryx.com/proof/care-rota): UK care staffing operations. Replaced a fragmented 90-column spreadsheet with a live system for cost, coverage, and compliance.
- [Fitosys](https://alchemetryx.com/proof/fitosys): Indian fitness coaching platform. Rebuilt lead capture, workout delivery, and client retention into an automated workflow.
- [Meet Prerna](https://alchemetryx.com/proof/meet-prerna): Independent artist booking & intake workflow. Automated consultation scheduling and artwork commissions.
- [PrimeraSkin](https://alchemetryx.com/proof/primeraskin): Dermatology and aesthetics clinic workflow. Structured digital intake and patient triage pipeline.
